arguments.name: apiId
arguments.description: (Required) ID of the API to connect.

arguments.name: basePath
arguments.description: (Optional) Path segment that must be prepended to the path when accessing the API via this mapping. If omitted, the API is exposed at the root of the given domain.

arguments.name: domainName
arguments.description: (Required) Already-registered domain name to connect the API to.

arguments.name: stageName
arguments.description: (Optional) Name of a specific deployment stage to expose at the given path. If omitted, callers may select any stage by including its name as a path element after the base path.
